env.userData: fresh empty temporary directory via AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA (interactive run: $TMPDIR/ud-p2-pad-b; this list replayed whole: $TMPDIR/ud-p2-pad-b2, and after the last fix $TMPDIR/ud-p2-pad-b3)
env.build: main at 7a04adf + the uncommitted rev 6 phase-2 working tree, with this run's fixes (see result.md)
env.window: 1440 × 868, in the background (backgroundThrottling is off under AETHER_TEST_USER_DATA)
env.input: Gamepad only. Before the first {wait}: Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled (a background window has no document focus, so :focus — and with it the pad's focus ring — never matches; a player's window has focus) and one eval that defines read-only helpers on window.__e2e (positions, the chapter's people and finds, a standing spot next to the next one). After it: only pad, wait, eval (read-only: no clicks, no focus(), no store writes) and shot. {pad:{toward}} leans the left stick toward a point read from those helpers, the way a player walks to what they see; {repeat} loops until the chapter is cleared.
env.note: The seed is rolled at random by New game, so the land differs per replay; the walk uses the chunk-centre ford rows (always walkable) and the chapter's people are found through the helpers, so the list replays on any seed.

model: openai · gpt-5.4-mini (Settings → Model default on a fresh userData: Cloud API, key from .env)

actions.eval: (async()=>{window.__e2e.t0=Date.now(); return {input: document.documentElement.dataset.input ?? null, menu:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b=>b.offsetParent).slice(0,4).map(b=>({t:b.innerText.trim(),disabled:b.disabled})), focus: document.activeElement?.innerText, keys: [...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-key')].filter(k=>k.offsetParent).map(k=>k.innerText+(k.dataset.pad==='true'?'(pad)':''))}})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('[role=dialog]'); const menu=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.innerText.trim()==='世界'); return {dialog: d?.getAttribute('aria-label') ?? null, focusInDialog: d?.contains(document.activeElement) ?? false, menuInert: menu?.closest('[inert]')!==null, ring: (()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})()}})()

(()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})()

({nav:[...document.querySelectorAll('.library__nav button')].map(b=>b.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' ')), focus: document.activeElement?.innerText, ring: (()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})(), keys: [...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-key')].filter(k=>k.offsetParent).map(k=>k.innerText+(k.dataset.pad==='true'?'(pad)':''))})

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<60;i++){if(document.activeElement?.innerText?.trim()==='開始') return {focus:'開始', ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));} return {focus: document.activeElement?.innerText ?? null}})()

(()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})()

(async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); for(let i=0;i<120;i++){const s=S.useSessionStore.getState(); if(s.screen==='play'&&s.activeInstance){window.__e2e.tPlay=Date.now(); return {ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, cartridge: s.activeInstance.instance.save.cartridge, seed: s.activeInstance.instance.save.seed}} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));} return S.useSessionStore.getState().screen})()

(async()=>({state: await window.__e2e.state(), keys: [...document.querySelectorAll('.ui-key')].filter(k=>k.offsetParent).map(k=>k.innerText+(k.dataset.pad==='true'?'(pad)':'')), prompt: [...document.querySelectorAll('kbd')].map(k=>k.parentElement?.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' ')).slice(0,3), hint: [...document.querySelectorAll('div,span')].find(e=>e.children.length===0 && /移動/.test(e.innerText))?.innerText ?? null}))()

(async()=>({ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, state: await window.__e2e.state(), hud: [...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(e=>/^大地/.test(e.innerText) && e.innerText.length<20)?.innerText ?? null}))()

(async()=>{for(let i=0;i<360;i++){const c=await window.__e2e.chapter(); if(c&&c.written){return {ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, npcs: c.npcs?.map(n=>n.name), treasures: c.treasures?.length, monsters: c.monsters};} const card=[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(e=>/撰寫下一章|寫作失敗|失敗/.test(e.innerText) && e.innerText.length<300); if(card && /失敗|錯誤|error/i.test(card.innerText)) return {failed: card.innerText}; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));} return 'not written after 180 s'})()

(async()=>({state: await window.__e2e.state(), card: (()=>{const l=document.querySelector('[data-layer=chapter]'); return l ? l.innerText.slice(-160) : null})(), ring: (()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})()}))()

(async()=>({state: await window.__e2e.state(), dialogue: (()=>{const l=document.querySelector('[data-layer=dialogue]'); return l ? {text:l.innerText.slice(0,400), choices:[...l.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>b.innerText.replace(/\n/g,' '))} : null})(), ring: (()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})()}))()

(()=>{const a=document.activeElement; if(!a||a===document.body) return null; const cs=getComputedStyle(a); return {text:(a.innerText||'').slice(0,40), outline:cs.outlineStyle+' '+cs.outlineWidth, shadow:cs.boxShadow}})()

repeat.until: (async()=>{const s=await window.__e2e.state(); const t=await window.__e2e.nextTodo(); return !t || !s.nearby || s.nearby.id!==t.id})()

actions.eval: (async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); const p=S.useLandStore.getState().progress; const e=p.episodes.e1; return {ms: Date.now()-window.__e2e.t0, cleared:e.cleared, summary:e.summary, met:e.stage?.met, found:e.stage?.found, carry:p.storyCarry, hudStory:[...document.querySelectorAll('div')].find(d=>/^故事 \d/.test(d.innerText)&&d.innerText.length<80)?.innerText ?? null, lastChoice:[...document.querySelectorAll('div,span')].find(d=>d.children.length===0&&/^上次選擇/.test(d.innerText))?.innerText ?? null}})()

(async()=>{const S=await import('/state/index.ts'); const w=S.useWorldStore.getState(); const a=S.useSessionStore.getState().activeInstance; return {version: a.instance.save.cartridge.version, combat: w.gameplayRules?.combat ?? null, story: a.cartridge.story?.episodes.map(e=>e.id+':'+e.kind+'@'+e.cx+','+e.cz)}})()
